title: Retire SNS down to the last-resort alerts
description: Remove SNS topics and the interim alarm email once replaced, keeping only the minimum in open question 6, including how we know the notification service itself has stopped. Ends with p.apyr.us documentation for the feature set.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Exactly two last-resort alerts stay: kanbus-a402b9. SES events move to EventBridge, which can carry them (SES publishes to the default bus only). Inventory: kanbus-78f229. Papyrus part: PPY-f66e91, PPY-819117.
